requirement: Every input has documented units, provenance, trust and availability
The feature path is causal and identical offline/online
No source lineage, label or hidden identity leaks into evaluation
Selection compares detection and false alarms with resource cost
acceptance_evidence: Frozen protocol and reproducible run bundle

requirement: WAN or blockchain failure does not halt local detection
acceptance_evidence: Failure-injection trace and bounded queue behavior

requirement: Explanations distinguish attribution from verified incident truth
Evidence is durable and independently verifiable
acceptance_evidence: Crash recovery, tamper and receipt tests

requirement: A real chain demonstrates independently validated transactions
Simulators expose the phenomena claimed in the evaluation
The GUI is a client of the service, with clear stale/offline states
A deployment can be installed, monitored, backed up and rolled back
Conclusions name the data and operational conditions supporting them
RSU and on-vehicle (OBU) profiles share one detection core; every evaluation reports results per profile; the OBU works with and without ego-sensor data
acceptance_evidence: Schema receiver-type field and ego channel with tests; per-profile benchmark tables

requirement: Driver warnings meet a separate, stricter false-alarm budget and stay lab/simulator-only until an HMI safety review is recorded
acceptance_evidence: Driver-budget result in P6; recorded HMI review decision before any road use

requirement: Every observation carries an authentication result (valid, invalid_signature, unknown_issuer, expired, revoked, unsigned, not_available) and revocation freshness, recorded separately from the ML score
acceptance_evidence: Schema tests; signed and invalid simulated traffic; outsider vs insider results reported separately
